structure: Starts at the take's own beginning (plays once as intro), then loops the region after loop_offset forever; the last 3 s are pre-blended into the audio before loop_offset, so the jump is seamless.
note: Loop is pitch-shifted +1 semitone(s) (ffmpeg rubberband); the _original.mp3 is the untouched Lyria take in its original key, so do not layer or cross-fade it with the loops.
